# Emergency Contacts

The Travel Assistance section provides emergency contact information to help users quickly access emergency assistance.

## Emergency Contacts

- Police – 100
- Ambulance – 108
- Women Helpline – 1091
- Tourist Helpline – 1363

## Emergency Travel Support

MAA also provides emergency travel support for situations where users need urgent travel assistance.

Options include:

- Book Emergency Travel
- Talk to MAA Now

# Home-Made Food

The Home-Made Food section allows users to explore food prepared by local home cooks.

## Features

- Search for cooks, cuisines, or dishes
- Apply filters
- View available home cooks
- View cook ratings
- View preparation time
- View location
- View food categories
- Explore popular dishes
- View menus

## Example Home Cooks

- Aiza Aunty
- Adeel Bhai
- Mubeen Didi

## Food Information

The platform presents information such as:
- Ratings
- Reviews
- Cooking time
- Location
- Cuisine type
- Popular dishes

# MAA Digital Companion Platform

## Project Overview

MAA is a digital companion web application designed to provide users with helpful everyday services through a single platform. The platform focuses on making daily life easier by offering home-made food services, medicine and health assistance, travel support, and an AI companion.

MAA is designed as a caring digital assistant that helps users manage different needs from one place.

## Project Purpose

The purpose of MAA is to provide users with a simple and supportive digital platform where they can access essential services and assistance.

The platform combines multiple services into one website:

- Home-made food
- Medicine and health assistance
- Travel assistance
- AI companion
- Emergency support
- User account management

## Target Users

MAA is designed for users who need convenient access to everyday support and services. The platform can be useful for:

- Students
- Working professionals
- Senior citizens
- People living away from home
- Travelers
- Users looking for an AI-based companion

## Main Features

### User Registration

New users can create an account using:

- Name
- Email
- Phone number
- Password
- Confirm password

The registration form also includes agreement to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

### User Login

Existing users can log in to their MAA account using the login option available on the website.

### Home Page

The home page introduces the MAA platform and provides navigation to its main services.

The main navigation includes:

- Home
- Food
- Medicine
- Travel
- Talk to MAA
- Login
- Get Started

The homepage also contains user testimonials under the "Loved by Many" section.

# Medicine & Health

The Medicine & Health section provides users with access to medicine-related services and health support.

## Main Options

- Order
- Reminders
- Health Tips

## Medicine Search

Users can search for medicines and add them to a cart.

## Example Medicines

- Paracetamol 500mg
- Vitamin D3 1000IU
- Cetirizine 10mg

The medicine section is intended to make medicine-related tasks more convenient for users.

# AI Companion — Talk to MAA

The "Talk to MAA" feature provides an AI-based conversational interface.

MAA communicates with users through a chat interface and is designed to provide supportive responses.

## Suggested Prompts

Users can interact with MAA through suggested prompts such as:

- How are you, MAA?
- I'm feeling stressed
- Suggest dinner
- I miss home

## User Interaction

Users can also type their own messages in the chat input.

The AI Companion is presented as a caring digital assistant that listens, supports, and checks on users.

# Travel Assistance

The Travel Assistance section helps users plan trips and access travel-related information.

## Main Options

- Plan Trip
- Travel Tips
- Emergency

## Trip Planning

Users can enter:

- Starting city
- Destination
- Date

After entering the required information, users can search for travel options.

## Popular Destinations

The interface displays popular destinations such as:

- Karachi
- Mianwali
- Raheem Yar Khan
- Kashmir
- Muzaffarabad
- Lyari

## Emergency Travel Support

MAA provides an emergency travel support section for situations where users need urgent travel assistance.

Options include:

- Book Emergency Travel
- Talk to MAA
